label: Thermal compact
note: IP-neutral. Issue #372: the thrown grenade. Hold the throw key (F) to aim (the view zooms in to aim_mag, as a pistol's does) and see the dotted arc; let go to throw one (it takes one 'item' from the inventory). It leaves the hand at throw_speed m/s along the view, lifted lift_deg, falls at gravity m/s^2 (the game's 20) along the planet's up, bounces off what it touches (bounce: the part into the surface that comes back, slide: what is left of the part along it) and rests once slower than rest_speed. It bursts when it touches a person, droid or vehicle, or when fuse_s runs out. The blast: everyone within blast_radius m takes blast_damage (the same at any distance), droids, speeders and the party barge are destroyed (vehicle_damage; the barge through its own explode), and the player and the player's droids are hurt too (the player takes player_damage). blast_size is the fireball (ExplosionFx.big, 1 = a ship); guards hear it out to noise_radius. The preview is preview_s seconds of the same steps, a dot every preview_every steps. hud: the word by the count on the HUD. drop: a trooper of one of these factions killed drops one with this chance (taken in reach m).
